The house is one room split by a curtain. Through the back window the gray wall of Dike Section 7 stands two meters from the step. A dark water stain runs down it from top to bottom. A rooster crows two houses away.
Mario... 'yung gamot ko. Tatlong piraso na lang.
Alam ko. Ako na ang bahala.
She smiles. The smile costs her breath.
Mario takes down the Milo can from the shelf. Inside: ₱ 2,500 in coins and small bills. Luz's two-week refill costs ₱ 1,900. Anna walks in holding a form.
Tay, pirma po. Project Katatagan, ₱ 1,500. Bukas na po ang deadline.
Tay! Drawing ko 'yung malaking pader! Umiiyak po siya kapag umuulan.
Kasi po may butas sa loob.
Mario laughs and rubs Migo's head. He does not look at the stain on the wall. Cacá's bed behind the curtain is still made. It has not been slept in.
Buy Luz's full refill with the school money
Pay Anna's fee and buy Luz only a one-week supply. She will take half doses.
Anna looks at the form for a long time. "Okay lang po, Tay," she says, in the voice she learned from him.
Mario, 'wag mo nang ibigay sa akin 'yan. May pasok si Anna.
Luz holds up the small bottle and says, "Kalahati lang ang iinumin ko. Tipid."
Mas matigas pa ako sa pader na 'yan.
The camera lingers on the stain.
At Aling Susan's store, a ledger notebook, a ballpen on a string.
Lima, anim. Sa labinlimang araw, anim na libo. Mabait ako, Mario. Si Turing, hindi.
Mario signs with a shaking pen.

The BiyaheX rider lounge sits beside Bay 1 of the VLW Cargo Hub: plastic chairs, a broken fan, and a TV playing a political ad for Mayor Lacson ("Isidro, Umaabante!"). The app has pushed a notice: base pay drops from ₱ 65 to ₱ 49 per drop, effective today.
Forty-nine! Pare, ang preno mo pa, nagko-concert na sa kalsada!
Preno ko? Ikaw nga, ang gulong mo, parang pancake.
Platinum rider na ako, Kuya Mario!
Platinum ka na, wala ka pa ring pang-gas.
Good morning, mga pogi! Libre ang kape. Huwag n'yo lang sabihin kay boss.
The room laughs. This is the last time in the chapter that it will feel light.

A condo guard keeps Mario at the lobby for twenty minutes. A customer cancels after Mario arrives, so he eats the cold lugaw on a curb and gives half to a boy selling sampaguita. The last customer, Tita Lourdes, tips him ₱ 50 and says:
The canteen is almost empty. Ramil sits across from Mario and slides his coffee over.
May special delivery ako. Hindi 'to sa app. Sealed box, kukunin sa Bay 4, ihahatid sa Maniquis Hardware. Back door. Tatlong libo isang takbo.
Tatlong libo? Para sa isang box?
Sa app, forty-nine. Sa akin, tatlong libo. Walang tanong, walang problema. Pili ka.
Bay 4 is a corrugated steel dock with a rolling shutter. A young loader, Kaloy, hands over a taped box. No waybill, no barcode.
Behind the office glass, a man in a gray polo watches without moving. This is Dado, though Mario does not know his name.
At Maniquis Hardware, the back door opens before he knocks.
Ikaw na pala ang bagong rider ni Ramil. Mario, tama?
Mario has never told anyone here his name. Ilagan hands him a sealed envelope. ₱ 3,000. Mario counts it twice at a red light with hands that will not stay still. He buys a small cake for Anna.
Mario finishes with ₱ 640. As he leaves, Tonyo walks out of Bay 4 carrying a taped box, grinning.
Sorry, pare. Sayang ang tatlong libo!
If saw_envelope is true, Mario watches the box until Tonyo is out of sight.
Ramil slides a plain envelope across the table. It is the width of a brick.
Papel. Papel at pasalubong. Hindi ko sasabihin, Mario. Pero fair ako. Pwede kang humindi.
Mario gets home at 11:40 PM. Cacá comes in at midnight. A new phone glows in his hand.
Ikaw, Tay? Palagi kang wala. Wala kang alam sa akin!
Mario hears his own voice and has nothing to say.
The phone glows in the dark. Mario turns to the wall. Minsan mas madali ang katahimikan.
Nakautang ako kay Aling Susan. Pang-bayad na 'yung overtime.
He slides the envelope into the Milo can.
Luz is angry for one second, then holds his hand. She also heard the can open, and says nothing about it.
He slides the envelope into the Milo can.
Luz says nothing. She heard the can open.
Luz is angry for one second, then holds his hand.
She puts a hand on his back.
